mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, login_fail_count, locked_until, data_scope_type, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM sys_internal_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, teacher_no, name, phone, password, avatar, teaching_type, teacher_level, campus_id, status, must_change_password, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, experience, good_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM sys_teacher_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, phone, name, avatar, status, campus_id, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM sys_student_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT campus_id FROM sys_user_campus WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_primary = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND p.status = 1

SELECT code FROM sys_permission WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND code IN
#{code}
